conceptFindings.change: The extra standalone $O$ after center of curvature is removed; $AOC$ and reverse path $COA$ remain.
conceptFindings.sourceEvidence: Raw p0186#3 gives AOC and COA on the same straight line. Both approved original translations identify the center of curvature. Both repaired translations still explicitly name that center and retain both ordered path labels.
conceptFindings.scientificReason: A radius from the spherical surface to its center of curvature is the local normal. Incidence along that radius has zero incidence angle and reverses along the same line after reflection. Deleting a redundant symbol does not turn the center into the focus or change the radius-normal condition.
conceptFindings.bilingualReason: Chinese '经过曲率中心' and English 'through the center of curvature' give the same incident condition; '沿原来的直线返回' and 'retraces the same straight path' give the same reversed path. Neither q3 view relies on the deleted standalone symbol.

affectedQuestionOptions.available-ray-construction: The surviving center-of-curvature ray remains a genuinely reflected available path under the explicit stem conditions.

conceptFindings.change: The existing 'same image point' is explicitly named $A_1$ again; native English paragraph breaks also change.
conceptFindings.sourceEvidence: Raw p0186#9 names A_1 for the image, for the construction and for the other reflected rays. The repair restores the third occurrence, while preserving any two convenient rays and the central-hole/remaining-surface example.
conceptFindings.scientificReason: In the stated paraxial real-image construction, two actual reflected lines from one object point that are noncoincident and share the finite image point uniquely determine that point by intersection. A third line can check it but is not necessary. A ray through a hole supplies no reflected line. One line alone is a locus, not a unique position.
conceptFindings.bilingualReason: Both texts retain one and the same image point, bold 'any two', and the loss of reflection at a medical mirror's hole. q3 explicitly supplies real-image, off-axis, actual-reflecting-surface and pairwise-noncoincident conditions in both languages. The added A_1 does not introduce a second image or expand the claim to wide beams, virtual-image actual convergence, duplicate rays or an image at infinity.

affectedQuestionOptions.ray-correspondences: The actual-reflecting-surface premise and paraxial limitation remain; the changed definition does not supply the four ray-direction answers in the learner-facing view.

affectedQuestionFindings.intentAndView: The collective ray/reflection task and same off-axis-point, paraxial, actual-surface premises are unchanged. Concept 6 still supports the local-normal explanation in the intent; concept 12 still supports the availability limitation. Neither repair changes learner wording or exposes an answer.

newAffectedOptionChecks.reason: Center-of-curvature incidence retraces its oblique line from the off-axis point, not an axis-parallel line. The retained rationale's substitution of focus for center still generates exactly this false correspondence.

An axis-parallel ray from the off-axis point strikes away from the pole and does not follow the local spherical normal. The unchanged focus rule applies instead. Treating the pole normal as the normal everywhere still generates the false retracing conclusion.

A focus-directed ray is not center-of-curvature normal incidence. The retained focus-to-parallel rule does not retrace the oblique incoming line. Confusing focus with center still generates the stated wrong procedure.

The center-of-curvature ray is normally incident, so zero incidence and reflection angles give reverse travel on its original straight line. The current concept retains exactly this rule without needing a standalone O.

The line from the pole through the center is the principal-axis normal. Off-axis pole incidence has nonzero angle and reflects at that angle, not automatically along the normal. The unchanged rationale distinguishes identifying the normal from equating all reflected rays with it.

affectedQuestionFindings.keyQualification: This set combines unchanged historical approvals for a/c/h with the new affected checks above, not a replayed current full review of every option.
affectedQuestionFindings.rationalesAndZHEN: Both language rationales preserve local normal versus focus, zero versus nonzero incidence, and the same distractor-generating substitutions. The deleted redundant O supplies no missing premise. All affected option truth values, wrong procedures and correct-set membership agree across languages.

affectedQuestionFindings.intentAndView: The complete-plan task still distinguishes two independent position constraints, unnecessary third-ray necessity, nonexistent hole reflection and one-line underdetermination. The view explicitly states actual remaining surface, real image and pairwise noncoincidence; these are candidate conditions, not unseen figure observations.

newAffectedOptionChecks.reason: All three may meet at the same A_1, but two distinct intersecting reflected lines already suffice. Adding the explicit third A_1 does not make the third line necessary; the retained third-ray-as-necessity misconception remains false.

The pole-directed ray goes through the hole, so no actual reflected line exists there. The restored image-point symbol does not create reflecting material or justify the fictitious pole reflection used by this plan.

Any pair of the three actual, pairwise-noncoincident reflected paths determines their common real image point A_1. The center-of-curvature ray remains valid after concept 6's repair, and the hole ray remains excluded.
A named common point does not supply its position from a single reflected line. That line alone contains many points; the second independent line is still needed to locate A_1.

affectedQuestionFindings.rationalesAndZHEN: Both languages preserve the same quantifiers, physical availability and sufficiency logic, with matching per-option truth, derivation and misconception. The new explicit A_1 is only an antecedent clarification.

affectedPackageRelationships.evidence: The changes occur in internal seed definitions and binding digests, not the q3 learner-facing options. Ray correspondence recognition and two-ray availability/sufficiency remain distinct tasks. No new duplicated option, cross-question answer cue or coverage omission is introduced by either repair.
affectedPackageRelationships.inheritedLimitations: Recognition still does not prove unaided writing, recall or independent drawing. Existing coverage/limitation wording is inherited, not newly relabeled as whole-card acceptance.
